title: All three deep-moment walls share ONE root crossover depth r*≈β=log_n q; the deficit is exactly the half-tower height a/2
evidence: Exact-arithmetic probes (prize regime n=2^μ, μ=8..32, β∈{4,5}, real NTT primes q≡1 mod n) compute each wall's crossover depth: scripts/probes/_407_conn/C011_three_walls_crossover.py, C011_largesieve_cap_check.py, C011_threshold_reconcile.py. (i) W-anomaly (CharSumMomentDeepWall.lean): reliable crossover r_max=2·log_n p−3=2β−3 (=5 at β=4, =7 at β=5), i.e. ~2β NOT β; the r_opt/r_max=a/2 deficit IS correct for this wall (already in-tree). (ii) W-largesieve (ManyTermResultantBound.lean): char-0 validity needs q>(2r)^{n/2}, so r<½·q^{2/n}; since n=2^μ sits in the exponent denominator 2/n, this CRUSHES to r*=½ (i.e. r*=0) for EVERY prize n, independent of β (cap_2r=1.0000 from μ=16 up). Reaching r=β=5 at n=2^32 would need log2 q>2^31·log2(10)≈7e9 vs prize ≤256 (short by ~2.8e7 in the log). The connection's own stated form r~log q/(n log r) numerically evaluates to ~1.5e-8, not β. (iii) W-Betti/KU (KowalskiUntrauBarrier.lean): has NO moment-depth crossover — it caps the subgroup SIZE d, max non-vacuous d*~log q/loglog q≈3..9, and the prize fixes d=n=2^μ≫d* so KU is simply vacuous. The three crossovers are {2β−3, O(1)=½, size-cap d*}; ratio r_max/r_cap between (i) and (ii) GROWS unboundedly (8→14). They are not one number r*≈β.
reduced_to: The surviving honest residue (qualitative, not the claimed quantitative coincidence): all three walls share the same SHORTFALL shape — needed-depth ~ log q vs reliable-depth ≪ that — so all three are vacuous at the prize and weld to the SAME BGK square-root-cancellation wall for thin μ_n. The exact a/2 (half-tower) deficit, however, is a property of W-anomaly ALONE (already proven in-tree in CharSumMomentDeepWall.lean), not a common invariant.
wall: BGK square-root cancellation for thin μ_n (Paley Graph Conjecture). All three tools are vacuous at the prize; the W-largesieve resultant bound q>(2r)^{n/2} is the worst-offender (needs astronomically large q), W-KU caps subgroup size, W-anomaly caps moment depth at 2β−3.
honest_note: Only the W-anomaly piece (sub-claim i, r_opt/r_max=a/2) is correct and is already axiom-clean in CharSumMomentDeepWall.lean; the unifying thesis grafts that wall's a/2 deficit onto the other two, but their crossovers are governed by completely different functions of (n,r): the largesieve cap has n=2^μ in the exponent DENOMINATOR (collapses to O(1) regardless of β), and KU caps a SIZE not a moment depth. I did not attempt a Lean packaging since the central coincidence is false; the three Lean files referenced are each individually correct, it is the cross-file 'one root r*≈β' synthesis that the probes refute. Recommend a DISPROOF_LOG entry for the quantitative coincidence claim while preserving the genuine qualitative 'all weld to BGK' observation.
